scripts.build:engine: bun build apps/engine/src/index.ts --compile --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --outfile dist/engine && sh scripts/codesign-macos.sh dist/engine
scripts.build:agent: bun build apps/agent/src/index.ts --compile --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --outfile dist/tunnel-agent && sh scripts/codesign-macos.sh dist/tunnel-agent
scripts.build:cli: bun build apps/cli/src/index.ts --compile --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --outfile dist/subkit && sh scripts/codesign-macos.sh dist/subkit
scripts.build:sk: bun build apps/sk/src/index.ts --compile --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --outfile dist/sk && sh scripts/codesign-macos.sh dist/sk
scripts.build:all: bun run build:engine && bun run build:agent && bun run build:cli && bun run build:sk
scripts.test:unit: SKIP_DOCKER=1 SKIP_DB_TESTS=1 bun test apps/engine/src/observability apps/engine/src/logging apps/engine/src/audit apps/engine/src/llm apps/engine/src/workflows apps/engine/src/execution/tests
scripts.test:integration: bun test apps/engine/src/db apps/engine/src/queue apps/engine/src/http apps/engine/src/webhooks
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:cli && bun run build:sk && bun test tests/e2e/
scripts.compose:reset: docker compose down -v && sh scripts/ensure-env.sh && docker compose up -d --build
